Pull request overview


Adds focused unit-test coverage for the semantic_components::RangeSensor component (addressing missing coverage noted in #2496) and makes the double→float conversion explicit when populating sensor_msgs::msg::Range.


Changes:



Add a new gmock-based unit test covering interface naming, value retrieval, message population, interface release, and lock-unavailable (NaN) behavior for RangeSensor.


Make the narrowing conversion from the state interface’s double value to the message’s float value explicit in RangeSensor::get_range().


Register the new test_range_sensor target in controller_interface CMake test configuration.



Reviewed changes


Copilot reviewed 3 out of 3 changed files in this pull request and generated 2 comments.





File
Description





controller_interface/test/test_range_sensor.cpp
New unit tests for RangeSensor, including NaN behavior when the handle lock can’t be acquired.



controller_interface/include/semantic_components/range_sensor.hpp
Explicit double→float cast in get_range() for clearer intent.



controller_interface/CMakeLists.txt
Adds the test_range_sensor gmock target and links required dependencies.
